gitCommit.subject: Shorten the prepayment lead and relabel the repayment-date field
gitCommit.body:
Shorten the prepayment lead and relabel the repayment-date field

- Hebrew prepayment lead: shorter, clearer, still says Bank of Israel
  formula and that every figure comes from the amortization schedule.
- Hebrew "מועד הפירעון" label: now "שנים מההלוואה" instead of
  "שנים מתחילת המשכנתא".
- English prepayment lead/follow-up wording: trimmed the same way.
- Hebrew penalty article: drop a repeated "עמלת" in favor of
  "עמלה", drop one over-long clause in the timing line, and make the
  "תחנת יציאה" notes terser by removing the redundant fee-exemption
  restatement.
- i18n housekeeping: keep `trackTypes.intro` and `charts.amortAria` as
  existing keys (removed the accidental `false`/empty stubs added to
  those keys), and rebuild the `charts` / `prepayment` sections so
  the Hebrew file is structurally valid TypeScript again.
- Also reduced a stray repeated word in one English help sentence.

No behavior change to the calculator; this is copy-only.
